summary: Bakkt, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of Distributed Technologies Research Global Ltd. (DTR) via wholly-owned Cypriot subsidiary Bividen Limited. The acquisition was structured as a stock-for-stock deal; Bakkt issued 11,316,775 shares of Class A Common Stock as consideration, equating to approximately 31.5% of the pre-closing fully diluted shares (excluding warrants), with a 196,532 share adjustment. The seller, Akshay Naheta, is Bakkt's CEO and board member. The board approved the deal; no external advisors named. The share issuance may cause dilution. Watch for post-close shareholder value alignment and potential Nasdaq compliance given the change in control.
